synopsis: After a tense week, Mark and Sarah sit in silence at dinner. Neither speaks, but the silence carries everything unsaid. When Mark finally breaks it with a small honest admission, they realize the silence was never the problem — the fear of being heard was.

constraints.characters: MARK (38, responsible, loving, proud, emotionally contained; freezes when facing vulnerability), SARAH (36, perceptive, patient, affectionate, gives him space to find his words)
constraints.style: Cinematic psychological realism. Warm domestic lighting. Minimal narration, strong facial micro-expressions, meaningful blocking and distance, restrained piano score.

story.story_context: After a tense week, Mark and Sarah sit in silence at dinner. Neither speaks, but the silence carries everything unsaid.
story.viewer_recognition: The emotional pattern is recognizable and relatable.
story.intended_resolution: Mark and Sarah move toward reconnection through honest vulnerability.
